# Your workflow is pinned to a SHA. Is what it loads?

> Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and check whether a reusable workflow or composite action it pins to a commit SHA itself loads a third-party action by a mutable tag underneath — a gap a top-level SHA pin does not close.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
